prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, hip-cut demi statue portrait, five-material body: real face and neck, one crystal arm, one stone arm, a water-filled glass torso, a short sealed glass left thigh-stub, and a short carved wooden right thigh-stub. ONE woman, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so her whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually finished thigh-stub tips just below her hip line, her face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop of just the face. Where her sculpted form comes to an end, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Romanian woman in Balkan glam makeup — warm fair-olive skin, thick dark straight-edged brows, a heavy black liner smoked out at the outer corners, deep brown shadow blended up to the crease, long dense lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour, a deep red matte lip with a crisp edge, long dark-brown hair in glossy voluminous waves, an intense, proud expression. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. On each ear a thick gold hoop with a gold coin drop.

Physique: A giant hourglass frame flaring at both ends — shoulders more than four times a normal woman's width, a colossal chest projecting past them, a big round belly, no waist at all, hips as broad as the shoulders, her left arm made of crystal, her right arm made of carved stone, her left thigh-stub a sealed glass tip, her right thigh-stub a carved wood tip.

Boundary (skin to material, at the collarbones): a single straight, flat line runs around the base of her neck and across both collarbones, nowhere lower, never reaching her chest — never jagged, never zigzag, a clean straight cut like a cross-section, exactly like a clean slice through a cast-glass sculpture. Real skin above this straight line, the material immediately below it. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step above her flesh, casting a crisp shadow. The vessel portion is already full of water right up to this same straight collarbone line and no higher.

Left arm (shoulder to hand): solid transparent crystal, solid deep blue sapphire crystal, with fine silky needle inclusions forming a soft star-like shimmer, near-midnight navy where thickest and pale cornflower at every thin edge, one continuous carved mass, never hollow, every wrist, palm, finger and knuckle the same crystal. Light passes straight through it; the backdrop is visibly bent inside it.

Right arm (shoulder to hand): carved from ONE solid block of genuine malachite, a rich green stone banded with concentric rings and swirling stripes, polished to a smooth glossy sheen, completely opaque, completely opaque, every wrist, palm, finger and knuckle the same stone. No light passes through it — only reflections on its polished surface.

Torso (chest, belly, hips): a sculpted vessel of thick, crystal-clear glass (unmistakably glass: thick, crystal-clear and polished, bright specular reflections, sharp white highlights, tiny trapped bubbles) in the exact shape of her torso, filled completely to the brim with clear emerald-green water — a distinctly different colour from her left thigh-stub below — no hollow space anywhere. Small bright fish and slow-drifting green water plants move freely through the whole filled torso, rising up to the collarbone line itself, never crowding.

Left thigh-stub (hip line to just below, where the thigh has barely begun): a small sculpted vessel of the same clear glass (unmistakably glass: thick, crystal-clear and polished, bright specular reflections, sharp white highlights, tiny trapped bubbles), filled with clear rose-pink water — a distinctly different colour from the torso's water above — holding a scattered handful of deep red rose petals drifting slowly. Just below her hip line, it curves inward and seals shut into its own small, smooth, rounded, closed tip — the vessel simply reaching its natural end there.

Right thigh-stub (hip line to just below): carved from the same solid block as the right arm's family of materials — here, genuine purpleheart wood, a striking deep violet-purple heartwood, unmistakably not a human skin tone, with fine straight grain lines running through it and a few darker plum-coloured streaks, polished to a hard satin sheen, completely opaque, completely opaque, the grain running unbroken to its tip. Just below her hip line, it curves inward and rounds off into its own small, smooth, satin-polished carved tip — the wood simply reaching its natural end there.

Where each material meets its neighbour (left shoulder, right shoulder, left hip, right hip), the two distinct materials sit flush against each other with a thin, clean seam, deliberate and precise, never jagged or torn — always the finish of a sculpture, each material keeping its own colour, clarity and surface completely separate from the one beside it.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a deep forest green on one side and a warm rose pink on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath her.

Pose: standing tall, her left hand (crystal) resting on her flared hip, her right arm (stone) held clear of her body, the hand relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: two large softboxes rake across her body from either side, so forest-green light glances off the left half and rose-pink light glances off the right half — passing straight through the crystal arm, the glass torso and the glass thigh-stub, while only reflecting off the stone arm and the wooden thigh-stub. A soft frontal light falls on her face and ears only. shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
